items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: Well I met him at the Copper Raider Hall.

ctx.x: Now where did you hear Joe Oliver? You mentioned hearing him.
Well I met him at the Copper Raider Hall. He's one of the good cornet players right behind Manuel Perez. Yeah, he took me at the Copper Raider Hall. An outstanding cornet player going.
Did those cornet players use many mutes? Different kind of things for me?
